full_page.content:
Page 32 Cont.
May 22 Mary Patricia Doyle - 29 - in Ford's - mental break - confused, etc. . . has - litttle boy and anxious husband and mother.
28 Mrs. Lillian Downey - 46 - Toxic - Goitre, twice on operation table - twice no operation ... Thank God - pray for further es- cape .
30 Marion Oberle - 20 - blind since birth excepting she has been able to distinguish between light and darkness - enrolled To-day.
31 Thanks - Mrs. Cath. Dalian - 30 - very threatening goitre - feared to be even cancer of throat and arm. Enrolled May 12th - Promised to enroll in Ser Mass Assoc'n as perpetual .. if improved in week - Comes to-night in perfect condition - has four little little ones - twins. Enrolles To-night perpetaully.
June
1942, June
June 1
Mrs. Agnes Markey - 38 - very rich in Bad Axe
Horace Shaw - 62 - Grayling, Mich. - Stroke May 16th. Drs give little hope.
Page 33
June 7 Katie McParlin - 75 - light stroke about Christmas-time last, has been unable to talk ever since, has been very clever till of late . now becomes discouraged.
8 Mrs. Ang. Ruffino - 37 - T.B. of Spine - on way to Ann Arbor Hosp- ital for very serious operation ... Dr's figure she will have at least a year and 6 mon's in a sort of cast or rack. They hope at least to check decay. Enrolls To-day for year - urged to frequent Communion and enrollment of Poor Souls in Ser. Masses.
Anna Sachs - 79 - fearful pain in hip - born of Cath. parents in Ger. - Mother dying very shortly after birth - father following in- side some month, she was raised by non-catholics and has been in doubt if ever baptized ... wants to start instructions.
Mrs. Josephine Larrocca - 34 - Very nervous believes herself pos- sessed
Gozel Rowley - Methodest - 5 - spastic-nerve condition - no con- troll of limbs, very weak.
